title: Special Projects in Bioengineering; Introduction to Starting MedTech Ventures
description: Focuses on the fundamentals of starting a medical technology-based venture. Topics covered will include: scientific strategy and innovation , regulatory affairs, clinical timeliness for success, relevant guest speakers, and much more. Students will understand the cycle of innovation in med-tech through the use of their own current/prior medically related project. Bioengineering Design competition teams and Capstone teams are highly encouraged to enroll; all majors welcome.
